item.title: TikTok will not introduce end-to-end encryption, saying it makes users less safe
item.description:

item.title: LLMs can unmask pseudonymous users at scale with surprising accuracy
item.description:
📝 One of them collected posts from Hacker News and LinkedIn profiles and then linked them by using cross-platform references that appeared in user profiles. Using the information taken from answers, the researchers were able to positively identify 7 percent of 125 participants. The results showed that the more movies a candidate discussed, the easier it was to identify them.
🔗 Read more: https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/03/llms-can-unmask-pseudonymous-users-at-scale-with-surprising-accuracy/
